llamacpp local provider routes requests via llamacpp/ model prefix with no auth

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'llamacpp/my-model'))
puts result.inspect
```
